host.description: The IP address or hostname to bind the listener to.

port.description: The TCP port to listen on.

reuse_port.description: Enable SO_REUSEPORT for the listener socket.

shutdown_timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for graceful shutdown.

cache_type.description: The type of cache backend to use.

cache_filename.description: Path to the SQLite cache database file.

default_zone_strict_testing.description: Whether to enable strict testing mode for the default zone.

default_zone_timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for the default zone.

zones_myzone_strict_testing.description: Whether to enable strict testing mode for the 'myzone' zone.

zones_myzone_timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for the 'myzone' zone.
